svg.title: The Missing 107: Louisiana's November 2024 Bohemia mineral lease sale
svg.desc: Documentary evidence reconciliation. Official November 2024 Louisiana notice advertised Bohemia Tract 45869 at approximately 107 net mineral acres. The November 13 sale summary lists nine state agency tracts, 481.553 acres nominated, but eight tracts, 374.553 acres awarded. Difference: one tract and 107.000 acres, exactly the proposed Bohemia mineral acreage. Louisiana's November 14 release did not list Plaquemines Parish among sold leases. Strong inference of no award in that sale; not a tract-specific rejection, and later status remains unknown.

Original official map may be viewed at the first PDF but is not rehosted. License: Copyright Final Vestige Studios, all rights reserved. Alt: The November 2024 state agency sale nominated nine tracts and awarded eight; 107.000 acres were not awarded, matching the advertised Bohemia Tract 45869, but subsequent lease history is unknown.
